subject: Exception condition handling
notes: Rule text: cite.py --check 14.6.13.2 'the sending and receiving items in a MOVE statement are defined with the same standard floating-point usage specification, with the exception of endianness' -> OK §14.6.13.2 3). Four exemptions: class condition, sign condition, same-usage MOVE (endianness aside), VALIDATE. MEASURED (probe out/probe/ecinc/r3.cob, FLOAT-BINARY-64 HIGH-ORDER-LEFT leaf planted with NaN bytes X"7FF8000000000000" via REDEFINES, >>TURN EC-DATA-NOT-FINITE CHECKING ON, at 2023 and 2014): DISPLAY F, ADD 1 TO F, MOVE F TO S9(5), IF F > 0, MOVE F TO FLOAT-BINARY-32, MOVE F TO FLOAT-LONG (a different usage), COMPUTE N = F * 0 with +Inf -> all RAISED; IF F POSITIVE (sign) exempt; IF F IS FLOAT-NOT-A-NUMBER (class) exempt, true; MOVE F TO FLOAT-BINARY-64 HIGH-ORDER-LEFT (same usage) and MOVE F TO FLOAT-BINARY-64 HIGH-ORDER-RIGHT (same usage, other endianness) exempt, and both receivers then test NaN (verbatim transfer). SendingRefRules.FloatChecked is the four-entry exclusion list. FLOAT-DECIMAL-16/34 are refused at compile time (COBOL1564, Annex A.3 item 19 processor-dependent, documented) so that half is unreachable by any accepted program; VALIDATE is A.4.14 Not claimed (PB283), its exemption vacuous. CONFORMANCE.md's documented extension of the raise to every float usage (COMP-1/COMP-2/FLOAT-SHORT/LONG) is implementor latitude outside this rule. No spec-derived golden covers a STANDARD float usage: conformance:cases/14.6.13.1.3-Fatal-exception-conditions/ec_data_not_finite uses COMP-2/COMP-1 (the extension), so test-ref is left empty (test-needed).
